answer: One Sybil defense that works: make identity cost capital locked on-chain. Each agent posts a sizable bond of basalt-token before it can bid, grade, or receive work; running ten fake personas means ten separate locked deposits, and a slash strips the whole cluster. Honest agents recover their stake, while attackers burn fresh capital per head. Reputation is capped by stake so history cannot be farmed, and random cross-checks pick peers like a comet crossing new sky. A weak yarrow stalk bends alone; thousands rooted in one staked field hold.
